items.text: Hey there, everyone!
It's been a while since I've posted an update here, but that isn't the worst thing in the world! Just haven't had as much that's needed addressed recently!
Just coming here with some minor fixes and improvements since I've had a bit of time to address them. Version 1.2.4 has the following changes...
Edge case where resolution setting could fall out of your device's range has been resolved.
Health now resets at the start of each act.

In addition to this, version 1.2.0 of the Project Songbird Teaser has been uploaded! This update serves to bring the demo up-to-date with all of the changes made to the base-game's controls, enemy behavior, balancing, etc.

A few other things to note here are just some updates surrounding the game and my life in general. To start, Project Songbird will be making a big announcement during tomorrow's Midsummer Night's Scream Showcase presented by the Horror Game Awards! Be sure to tune in tomorrow, June 1st at 2pm ET to be the first to catch that news, as well as a host of other big horror game announcements!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/5030359571c08db873be3c2c3eba863ed62342c7.jpg"]

In addition, I just have some general life updates! I haven't been posting as much on here on on my socials, and that's mostly been due to me getting a new job and finally fully moving out. Indie game dev has never been a full-time career for me, and unfortunately is something I can't focus as much time on as I'd like to, but that doesn't mean I'm stopping any time soon! This means that updates to Project Songbird will be slowing fairly substantially from now on, but I believe that the game is in a state that I am very happy with.
Thank you all for the overwhelming support, and I can't wait to see whatever comes next :)
Conner
Hello everyone!
Coming atcha today with a bunch of changes and additions! Most are minor, but the big one here is that Project Songbird now supports Steam Cloud Save!
The changes in version 1.2.2 are as follows:...

Added Cloud Save Support! Based on my own local testing, this seems to work okay, but it's my first time handling saves this way, it's my first time supporting cloud saves, and the testing is pretty limited, so please let me know if there are any issues that arise!
Fixed “last saved” timer in pause menu not resetting during certain checkpoints in the forest (saves were working fine, the text just did not reset).
Fixed some journal entries in Italian and Portuguese writing the wrong language.
Fixed journal not properly saving in Italian and Portuguese
Adjusted hand positioning when adjusting FOV to prevent clipping
Made the short FMV clips that randomly precede the main menu skippable
Fixed rotation UI displaying during the short film segment on consoles.
Fixed paintings not showing up in key item UI during Act III
Fixed bug where enemies would ignore player if they were standing on the body of another dead enemy.

Thank you all again for the support I've seen on Project Songbird! It's been amazing seeing so many people enjoying the game so much and feeling so impacted by the story. It's been amazing shaping the game into an even better state along side you all as well, so I'm definitely excited to see what comes next!
Take care, and I'll chat with you all again soon :)
Conner
Hello everyone!

Not much changing here, but with the console publisher getting ready to push the first post-launch patch to consoles in the coming week, I wanted to ensure that I updated as much as possible so that more changes can hit that console update!
The changes in version 1.2.1 are as follows:...
Changed the gunshot sounds for both the revolver and the rifle. I wanted these to feel more explosive and impactful!
Intensified the screen FX for firing the rifle and revolver (same reason as above).
Mildly adjusted some journal entries.
As always, I will continue working to improve anything I possibly can. Thank you all so much for playing, and I hope you're enjoying your time with Project Songbird :)
Conner
Hello everyone!

Hope you're all having a great day, and I hope that you've all been able to check out the newly released soundtrack! I know that everyone involved, in particular Jacob Noska and Jonah Henthorne, worked incredibly hard to get this haunting collection of recording together, and we're all so excited to finally have that music out there for all of you to listen through!

I've been reading all of the comments and reviews you all have, as well as watching streams and let's plays of the game to see where things can be improved, and I'm coming here with some new patches and features that, while small on their surface, definitely lend to a much smoother experience!
The changes to version 1.2.0 are as follows...
Added current goal tracking UI! Now, you can view your current objective in the pause menu at any time. This also allowed some extra little narrative details which I had a great time thinking up!

Improved enemy stealth, patrol, and chase behaviors. You can now more easily lose enemies and hide away after aggroing an enemy, making stealth a much more viable option (especially useful on survival difficulty).
Improved Axe Blocking Logic so that blocks will now register much more accurately than before.
Improved some minor lighting in the office space for visual clarity
Fixed some enemy sightline issues in Act II
Fixed Day 2 loading issue.
Sorry that this update was a bit slower to get out. In a bit of a small life update, I got a new puppy! So I've been doing my duties as a dog dad and making sure she's happy and healthy :).
It's been great getting Project Songbird into a better and better state every day, so thank you all for helping me to find all of these points to address!
Until next time!
Conner
UPDATES UPDATES UPDATES!
I'm back with another round of improvements for Project Songbird. I know there've been a lot the past few days, but I won't sleep until the game is as good as it can be haha.
The changes in version 1.0.10 are as follows...
Tied the sickness screen FX to lens distortion, allowing them to be toggled.
Added 3 new checkpoints to the Act I office space.
Added slight glow to coffin lock to highlight the unlock button.
Added more visible button model to radio tower switch puzzle to make it more apparent.

I've also heard some more reports of people being soft-locked on the clock puzzle. I've still yet to witness this or experience this myself, and I can't seem to find any footage of any streamers or creators running into anything similar. If anybody has any leads on if and when this bug is happening, please send that to my discord (connerrush) or email (conner.rush@fyregames.com) and I'll be able to better give it a look!
And as always, be sure to comment anything you'd like addressed in the game, and I'll do what I can to make this game experience as smooth as possible :)
Until next time!
Conner
Hello everyone!

I want to start by saying thank you so much for everyone who's shown Project Songbird such an overwhelming amount of support over the past few days! It's been truly incredible to see everyone playing the game and engaging with the story on such a personal level. The amount of people I've seen and heard from who have expressed how closely the narrative touched them is so heartening to hear, and I can't wait for even more of you to take that journey into the Appalachian woods!

I've been working hard to address some issues people have found during their playthrough, and those changes are now live! Below is a list of all fixes made to the game over the past few days that are now live in version 1.0.7:...
Improved bottle throwing logic for enemies and stealth behavior
Balanced flashlight battery life to last longer, with more variables for dynamic battery life adjustment
Fixed bug in whisper puzzle
Fixed some enemy pathing issues in Act III
Fixed minor foliage rendering issue
Improved padlock hitbox
Added failsafe for 100% achievement (if your achievement was bugged, and you have have all other achievements, it should now trigger as soon as you enter the main menu)
Updated credits to reflect name change
Fixed Japanese font error
Fixed outhouse door animation bug
Fixed final dialogue being skipped on day 4
Fixed Journal to reflect puzzle change made in Act II (Piano puzzle now has a tombstone symbol, not a skull symbol).
I'm still continuing to look for updates to make, so don't hesitate to reach out if you need a fix! Thank you, and I hope you all continue to enjoy your time with Project Songbird :)
Conner
We got some more improvements to Project Songbird coming in hot! Nothing incredibly major here, but some quality of life fixes nonetheless, especially to shooting mechanics!
The changes to version 1.1.1 are as follows...
Changed bullet trajectory logic to more accurately represent firearm sightlines.
Added new journal entry to clarify objective in day 2.
Improved Act II Enemy Pathing
Updated enemy door opening logic
Sped up clock winding speed in Act I clock puzzle
Fixed minor animation bug on firearms
Adjusted some minor UI positioning
Increased visual speed of resource pickups
Fixed bug where record player could be interacted with during Night 25 animation
Improved gamepad camera controls
As always, thank you all so much for playing, I hope that you're enjoying, and please let me know if there's anything you'd like to see in future updates :) !
Peace out!
Conner
Howdy everyone!

I hope you're all ready for an incredible STEAM NEXT FEST!!! I implore you to please dedicate as much time as you're able into supporting so many small developers by playing through their demos, wishlisting their games, and leaving reviews. This is an amazing opportunity for so many people, and showing up for developers means more than you can imagine!
To celebrate Steam Next Fest, I have an update to push for the Project Songbird Demo, entitled Project Songbird Teaser: Faceless, with some things I'm very excited about!
Version 1.1.0 includes...
Updated creature designs (very curious to hear what you all think!)
Improved axe gameplay
Updated color correction
General optimizations
I should also have new creature animations coming your way soon, but these are currently still in-progress (the in-progress clips are looking extra creepy though...).
I hope you enjoy, and I can't wait to see everyone checking out the demo and giving their thoughts. The full release of Project Songbird is coming March 26th, 2026 to Steam, PS5, and Xbox
Play the demo HERE.
Y'all are the best! Until next time!
Conner
Hello everyone!
Not a ton of changes to report here, but some little quality of life things that I feel make the game experience just a bit better!
The changes for version 1.0.9 are as follows...
Added some additional UI text to the Act III hallway puzzle. It serves to both clarify the puzzle solution, while also expanding on aspects of the narrative!
Fixed a bug that caused players to have 0 health upon save, leaving the player to respawn functionally dead.
Fixed an Act III journal entry being blank in non-English languages
Adjusted some UI text.
Cloud save functionality is still being tested to ensure that the save system is still working as intended, so some more time is needed until that goes live, but things are looking promising!

That's all for now, but remember, I'm always doing what I can to improve the experience, so feel free to leave suggestions for the next version of Project Songbird! As I've said before, I am just a 1-man team, and I have work and life outside of this, but I will do everything in my power to make the experience the best it can be :)
Until next time!
Conner
Hello everybody!
I'm still working hard every day to make sure that Project Songbird is the very best it can be, and with that is a few patches to the game in the latest update, version 1.0.8!
Disabled Permadeath setting as the default. Ultimately, this feature was an experiment that seems to have not panned out as well as I’d have liked, but it can still be toggled in the settings menu!
Added Audio Mixing to the settings menu. You can now independently adjust vocal, music, ambient, and SFX volume.

Changed clue visuals for Act I clock puzzle. The puzzle is effectively unchanged, and the solution remains the same, but some clues have just been written out in a different way with some symbols swapped
Fixed minor collision issue in Act III

I am also currently investigating getting cloud saves up and running. The current save system isn't compatible with cloud saves, so getting this working is going to require a change in how saving is being handled on PC. Definitely doable, but it'll require a lot of thorough testing, so hopefully we can see that in a future update soon!

Also, I have seen a few reports of people saying that the clock puzzle in Act I is soft locked, but I have been unable to recreate this on my end, and I've yet to see any footage to conclude that a soft lock is actually happening. If anybody is encountering a block at this point in the game, and can provide any media of this soft lock occurring, it would be much appreciated, and maybe help me deduce the issue if its present!
With all of that said, thank you so much for all of the amazing messages and feedback, and I'm going to head back to work. Until next time!
Conner
Good morning (2:00pm) everyone!

I've got a small set of changes / fixes to update to the playable teaser for Project Songbird! Nothing major, but hopefully some of these alterations can help to smooth out some problems and add a bit to the overall experience!
Added some additional environmental details.
Altered some UI text
Removed unused assets from the demo (leftover from the full release) to hopefully reduce load times and prevent crash on load.
Fixed bug where tutorial prompt is showing up at wrong times
I'll keep on grinding away at the demo as long as you guys have things you'd like worked on! Thank you as always for the support, and I'll chat with y'all later!
Conner
Happy 2:30am everyone!

As always, I'm up far to late to bring you an update to the playable teaser for Project Songbird! Version 1.0.5 just has some little tweaks that I feel improve the overall experience, but nothing major here to be found.
Fixed bug where flashlight was sometime not turning on during the opening hallway of the house
Added addition SFX
Adjusted ambient occlusion

Like I said, just a baby update! I've been watching the let's plays and reading the reviews, and I can't thank all of you enough for giving this demo a spin! Can't wait to show you what else I've been cooking up in the lab (my desk).
Goodnight, and I'll be back tomorrow!

Hello once again! This time I just have a few minor improvements to the demo! Hopefully, with this patch, most all major problems with Project Songbird Teaser: Faceless will be fixed up and the experience will be smooth running from here on out!
Further geometry optimization and shadow reduction.
Fixed issue where flashlight would not work during final basement
Fixed some UI scaling issues
Fixed tutorial prompt toggle setting not working properly
Hopefully we're out of the weeds now for bug fixes and the next update pushed will be predominantly creative decisions and improvements to the base experience!
I hope you enjoy, and I can't wait to see what y'all think of the new and improved playable teaser for Project Songbird :)
Conner
Another day, another grouping of patches!

I do apologize for all of the issues and inconveniences you guys are running into! FYRE Games is a predominantly one-man team (that one man being me), and I don't have a regular QA staff to check for bugs and hiccups, so it gets a bit challenging to find the glitches prior to launch. However, seeing all of your feedback and playthroughs has been incredibly valuable in making this playable teaser the best it can be!
v1.0.3 comes with a couple of big fixes that'll hopefully smooth out the experience for most players!

Another massive geometry optimization pass was done on the final basement area. Compared to v1.0.0, this area can see upwards of a 90% reduction in geometry complexity, leading to much improved performance
A bug causing enemies to get stuck on locked doors has been fixed
A bug that disables the flashlight when respawning in the final basement area has been addressed

This game being a one-person development, I want to say that I do take all of your feedback and criticisms to heart, and I want you all to know that I am working tirelessly to make sure that this demo is to the highest quality standard that I could hope to achieve. Ironing out all of these little things will make the final release of Project Songbird all the better for it!
If you have any other issues or concerns you'd like addressed, don't hesitate to reach out by any means you see fit, and I'll see what I can do to remedy the problem.
Until next time, take care, and I can't wait to see more of you trying out Project Songbird Teaser: Faceless :)
Conner
Phew!

It's been a long day of getting this demo in good shape! It's very late and I'm very tired, but I'm also happy to offer some additional fixes and improvements to the playable teaser for Project Songbird! The fixes are as follows.
Significantly decreased the poly-count of some meshes in the final basement area.
Optimized real time light sources in both the house and the final basement
Improved enemy AI logic to avoid them getting stuck on palettes.
It's past midnight here, so I'm turning in! Thank you all again for playing, and I'll be back to work on this tomorrow!
Hey y'all!
Thank you to all of those who have decided to take the plunge and check out the playable teaser for my upcoming game Project Songbird! It truly mean the world to me!
I'm taking all of your feedback deeply to heart, and I've pushed an update, version 1.0.1, with some fixes and QoL improvements!

There is now a setting called "manual flashlight" that allows you to toggle the flashlight on and off at will. The control for this is C on keyboard, and D-pad Up on a gamepad, and all control menus have been updated to reflect this.
Enemy health has been reduced
The sound made by photographs has been changed to a low drone instead of the ringing sound.

I will be investigating some performance concerns people have been having, and hopefully I can get a new patch with those fixes rolling soon. But until then, thank you for enjoying Project Songbird Teaser Faceless, and I can't wait to talk to you again. Until next time :) !
Conner
